name: Geosolar Technologies, Inc.
summary: GeoSolar Technologies, Inc. focuses on developing sustainable energy systems by leveraging both solar and geothermal power. The company designs "SmartGreen Home" solutions, which are engineered to significantly reduce energy consumption and lower the carbon footprint of both residential and commercial properties. Additionally, it provides "SmartGreen Buildings" specifically for the commercial market, among other innovative projects. Established in 2020, GeoSolar is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.
